Yes, most likely a court will refuse to enforce the bar against assigning the right to payment. This is a sale of goods, so UCC § 2-210(2) allows assignment of a right to damages for breach, or of a right arising from the seller's due performance of its entire obligation, despite a contrary agreement. UCC § 9-406(d) also overrides contract terms that prohibit assigning a right to payment, so the center must pay the assignee once it has notice and the distributor has performed.
